original_content_full:
The paper "Techniques for GPU-based Color Quantization" by Matthias Trapp, Sebastian Pasewaldt, and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a contribution to the 27th International Conference in Central Europe on Computer Graphics, Visualization and Computer Vision (WSCG 2019). The conference will be held in Plzen, Czech Republic from the 27th to 31st of May.
